windowTitle: Serial integration stage 7 - complete the portable Candidate installation configuration
scope: Complete the Cloud-owned portable Candidate installation contract for the supported tencent-tke provider and for the per-binding application origin. The owner-enforced configuration facts were absent from, or not forwarded by, the portable assets that ship and run those owners. No provider, cluster, Instance or production action.

findings.fact: services/fabric/internal/fabric/tencent_provider.go NewTencentProvider computes installationErr from OPL_WORKSPACE_DOMAIN, OPL_WORKSPACE_IMAGE, OPL_K8S_NAMESPACE and OPL_TENCENT_PROVISIONER_BIN, and validateInstallationConfig fails every kubectl action while it is set; TencentProvider.Readiness (tencent_provider_runtime.go) additionally requires OPL_CLOUD_IMAGE, OPL_IMAGE_PULL_SECRET_NAME, OPL_WORKSPACE_STORAGE_CLASS, TENCENT_DEPLOY_KUBECONFIG_REF and RUN_TENCENT_CREATE_RELEASE_EXECUTION=1. Container environment of a rendered compose.fabric-tencent-tke.yaml contained none of them, so the portable TKE Fabric could not build a usable provider or pass readiness.
findings.consequence: compose.fabric-tencent-tke.yaml now forwards every fact the provider validates or reports, and mounts the TKE deploy kubeconfig read-only from TENCENT_DEPLOY_KUBECONFIG_HOST_PATH to TENCENT_DEPLOY_KUBECONFIG_REF.

findings.fact: services/fabric/internal/fabric/tencent_provider.go callKubectl runs protectedresource.FromEnv().Check(target) for every mutating kubectl verb (apply/create/patch/delete/scale); Config.Validate requires OPL_SYSTEM_COMPUTE_NODE_POOL_ID, _MACHINE_ID, _NODE_NAME, _MACHINE_TYPE and OPL_FABRIC_TENCENT_TKE_PROVIDER_PROFILE_JSON, so Fabric refuses every provider/cluster mutation while they are unset. The portable assets declared none of the five OPL_SYSTEM_COMPUTE_* facts, although services/control-plane/ops/production-manifest.ts already requires them for a tencent-tke install.
findings.consequence: The assets now forward and declare exactly the facts the guard reads.

findings.fact: services/control-plane/internal/server/workspace_application_origin.go parseWorkspaceApplicationOriginHost returns not-a-binding-origin when OPL_WORKSPACE_APPLICATION_DOMAIN is empty, and services/serve/internal/delivery/routeorigin.go uses the same name for ApplicationEntryURL. compose.yaml did not forward it and opl-cloud.env.example did not declare it, so an install built from the published template could not dispatch or publish the per-binding application origin that the Instance Ingress wildcard routes.
findings.consequence: The base Compose now forwards the declared value and the template declares the installer input, keeping the setting optional but explicit rather than undiscoverable.

findings.fact: services/fabric/cmd/opl-tencent-provisioner refuses every non-dry-run Tencent mutation unless RUN_TENCENT_CREATE_RELEASE_EXECUTION is "1"; the portable assets neither declared nor forwarded it.
findings.consequence: The template declares it as 0 with an explicit statement of what 1 authorizes, and the overlay forwards the installer's value instead of hardcoding a permissive one. No charge, purchase, renewal or deletion is performed here.

verification.detail: Four tests: the overlay forwards every protected-resource fact read from guard.go and every fact the provider constructor and Readiness require (extracted from their source), mounts the kubeconfig read-only, the template declares them all plus the application-origin domain, and the base Compose forwards the origin domain both readers use.

Rendered with a disposable env file: the Fabric container receives all fourteen provider facts with OPL_FABRIC_PROVIDER=tencent-tke, RUN_TENCENT_CREATE_RELEASE_EXECUTION=0 and the read-only kubeconfig bind mount; the Control Plane receives OPL_WORKSPACE_APPLICATION_DOMAIN. No image pull, provider call or cluster access.
13 contract test files pass, including the retained portable Local-Docker asset and product-distribution tests.

verification.command: npm run test:ownership && npm run validate:product-boundary && npm run verify:local
verification.detail: Test ownership, product boundary and the full local gate (source tests, contract tests, Console browser suite, database-free Go tests, whitespace) are green.

notRun: Candidate image build (owner-actor dispatch) and Instance deployment.
Any Tencent provider or cluster mutation; no real charge, purchase, renewal or deletion.
claimBoundary: This receipt claims the portable Candidate assets now declare and forward the facts their Cloud owners require, and that the assets render with a disposable env. It claims no Candidate image, no deployed installation, no provider action and no Instance receipt.
